items.summary: Unfunded node smoke and funded mainnet canary for xchange-uniswap require the hardened node, wallet funding, and separate approval.
items.details: Runbook in xchange-uniswap/README.md; deployment code hashes must be pinned before funded use.

items.summary: OWASP dependency-check NVD scan cannot run without an NVD API key; OSV audit of the resolved compile graph is clean as a substitute.
items.details: Configure nvdApiKey (settings.xml or -DnvdApiKey) and re-run mvn org.owasp:dependency-check-maven:check.
